lines: The cavern widens into a natural gallery — and you find what's left of a raider forward camp. Fire pits still warm. Supply crates pried open and abandoned. Whoever was here left in a hurry.
Boot prints in the frost lead deeper into the Nightside, converging on a single direction. Southeast. Toward something they wanted badly enough to move their entire operation.
The fauna have already moved in to reclaim the space. You're not the only one following the trail.

A supply ledger, hastily discarded. Most entries are mundane — rations, ammunition, cold-weather gear. But the final entries stand out:
'Week 6: Voss ordered all personnel to the Spire. Full garrison deployment. Something woke up down there — the walls are humming, the geometric patterns are glowing. He says it's what we came for.'

'Week 7: Last supply run. The Spire's outer defenses are fortified. Voss won't say what he found, but he's posted guards on every level. Whatever it is, it's important enough to abandon this outpost.'
The Spire. They found something in an ancient structure — and they're guarding it with everything they have.

actions.text: Find the Spire of Vigil — follow the raider trail southeast

lines: A personal journal, leather-bound and frost-damaged. The handwriting is careful, educated — not what you'd expect from a raider:
'Day 12: The crystal formations here are extraordinary. Geometric precision that no natural process could produce. I told Voss — he doesn't care about the science. He cares about the power readings.'

'Day 18: Found a crypt entrance to the north. Ancient construction. The same geometric patterns as the deeper formations. Voss says to ignore it — the Spire is the priority. But I think the crypt predates the Spire by millennia.'

'Day 23: The crypt. I went back. The walls respond to light. Not heat, not vibration — light specifically. Sol-frequency light. How is that possible? This structure was built before humans ever reached Erith.'
— K. Brenn, Luddite Surveyor
The Unbounded scout is propped against the cave wall, one arm wrapped in bloodstained bandages. She watches you approach with wary eyes.
'Lightkeeper. You're heading for the Spire.' It's not a question.
'The armored ones — the Luddites — they found it three months ago. They've been digging into it, fortifying it, trying to understand it. They think it's a weapon.'
'It's not a weapon. It's a node. Part of a network that runs beneath the entire planet. The Unbounded have known about it for generations — we just never had the tools to activate it.'
'Your Sol technology does. That's why the walls glow when you get close. The Spire recognizes what you carry.'
'Be careful in there. Voss is desperate. Desperate people fight hardest.'
You apply the medkit to her wounds. She nods — grateful but unsurprised. The Unbounded don't waste words on what's understood.
'There's a crypt entrance to the north of here. Ancient — older than the Spire, maybe. The raiders found it but didn't explore it. Too focused on the prize below.'
'If you have time, it's worth seeing. The architecture there... it will change how you think about this planet.'
